defects.description: Missing 'Email Address' input field and its label entirely from the canvas.
Missing 'Save Changes' primary button below the input fields.
Missing 'Cancel' ghost-style button below the input fields.
Input field has no visible border or container definition, making it look like a raw background rectangle rather than a functional input component.
Placeholder text 'Enter your display name' is very faint with low contrast against the light blue input background.

Apply proper border or container styling to the input fields to make them look like finished UI components.
